$comment: zheref/Ztyle's reviewer identities, as DATA, so `nen pr ready` can decide CON-32 readiness here instead of refusing. Authored at Hatsu adoption on 2026-10-22 from the owner's choice: the `hanten` review round AS A CHECK, modelled on zheref/KroApple's shape (maintainer ruling 2026-10-05 there). No AI bot round is waited on. `nen pr ready` counts a SUCCESS of the `hanten` check -- the job of .github/workflows/hanten.yml, which runs ci_scripts/hanten_gate.sh against the pull request body -- as the round. The check attests the BODY, not the review: whoever can edit the body can write a passing section; the check makes an unsettled or missing review visible, and the merge stays a human decision. Nothing here was read off live pull requests, because the repository had none at adoption; revisit the delivery block once real PRs exist.

reviewers.$comment: The hanten round as a check. The login pattern is anchored to a name no reviewer posts under: the check is the round, never a review.
reviewers.name: hanten

$approval: POLICY. `review-round-only` with no default approvers, as in zheref/hatsu's own gates.json and the maintainer's ruling of 2026-09-12: the declared round is the review, a separate APPROVED review is not required, and the human merge decision stays outside the automated verdict. DELETING `approval_policy` makes the loader refuse the empty approval set; it is load-bearing.

delivery.$comment: What a delivery pull request looks like here: opened by the maintainer on their own credentials from a Hatsu branch. The branch template in nen/workflow.json is {model}/{persona}/{descriptor}, so the head prefix is the surface's model token.

checks.$comment: A maintainer's ruling that a named check is not watched goes here, never a chat line or a hand-passed --exclude-check. Read at the pull request's BASE. An empty list is a decision: nothing is excluded.

round_quorum.$comment: At least `minimum` of `any_of` must have a round. This group is hanten alone; a met quorum fulfils the owed round of an unavailable member.

round_policy.$comment: stallMinutes: a pending review request older than this reads not-ready (reviewer round stalled). minRounds / maxRounds: the reviewer-round floor and ceiling, as Hatsu's contracts/round_policy.default.json states them.
